judgements.reason: Both are finished in the baseline and sorry-free: root systems have existsUnique_dynkinType, the Coxeter presentation, strongExchange, Matsumoto, longestElement and the per-type simplyConnectedRootDatum, while semisimple algebras have Wedderburn uniqueness, skolemNoether, the centralizer theorem, BrauerGroup.instCommGroup and even the Layer 6 summit BrauerGroup ℝ ≃ ℤ/2. Neither has any missing theory left, including the optional Layer 0 items, which TauCeti/RingTheory/Jacobson/MulOpposite.lean discharges.

Root systems are built, Layers 1-6, with no missing theory. Ado-Iwasawa has no file in either tree and needs a stack of eight new layers: the injectivity half of PBW (only spanning exists, and ai_injective is proved for abelian L alone), the nilradical nil L, noncommutative derivations lifted to U(L), derivation-stable cofinite ideals, Levi decomposition for Lie algebras, and the whole characteristic-p central p-polynomial and Krull-intersection route.

Ado-Iwasawa is one self-contained chapter of Lie theory with no external imports, resting on Mathlib's Engel/solvable/BaseChange API and Tau Ceti's PBW filtration. Analytic number theory still lacks the zero-free region and a Tauberian theorem for PNT (Wiener-Ikehara untouched), explicit formulas and zero-density estimates, Hecke L-functions and the analytic class number formula (which need ideles, not begun in GlobalNumberFields), Halasz mean values, and then AN.8-AN.9's Sato-Shintani prehomogeneous zeta, adelic algebraic groups, the Selberg trace formula and Bost-Connes systems - 69 external stages over 19 roadmaps.

Analytic number theory's first two stages are largely in the baseline already (riemannZeta with completedRiemannZeta and its functional equation, DirichletCharacter.LFunction with continuation and gamma factors, Hurwitz zeta, Dirichlet's theorem, and Tau Ceti's Perron kernel and psi-to-pi transfer), so its missing theory is the analytic middle plus two heavy late stages. Class field theory has thirteen strictly stacked unbuilt layers above the Tate-cohomology and formation suppliers - class formations, Tate's theorem, the Artin map, the local invariant and Kummer/duality package, the local class formation, local existence, the Weil group, the Brauer sequence with the two fundamental inequalities, global reciprocity, global existence and the class fields - and its idele foundations in GlobalNumberFields have not been started at all.

Class field theory is deeper as a single chain (13 stacked layers plus adeles and ideles from nothing), but q-series needs more distinct bodies of theory: Kloosterman sums and the Rademacher exact formula, half-integral-weight and metaplectic multipliers from MetaplecticAutomorphicForms MP.7-MP.8, Bruinier-Funke harmonic Maass forms and the ξ operator, Zwegers' indefinite theta completions, Habiro rings and quantum invariants, and QM.6's moonshine stage, which owns the FLM moonshine module, the no-ghost theorem and Borcherds' denominator identity outright - 131 external stages over 27 roadmaps.

Reductive groups II is one coherent unbuilt theory - point topologies, Weil restriction, valued root data, Bruhat-Tits buildings, parahorics and the dual group - over a base roadmap that at least has group schemes, maximal tori and Borels. Q-series must additionally build the Rademacher circle-method machinery, harmonic Maass forms, Zwegers' mock completions, metaplectic half-integral-weight forms, quantum/Habiro invariants and the moonshine VOA chain, and its closure contains 2 stages of ReductiveGroupsPartII itself along with 129 others.

Both start from an unfinished base: reductive groups II needs conjugacy of maximal tori and Borels (still missing, so the general root datum is out of reach) plus buildings and parahorics from zero, while perfectoid spaces already has Tau Ceti's sorry-free Spa, rational-subset and sheaf-criterion apparatus. But perfectoid spaces must build several separate imported theories that do not exist at all - almost ring theory, diamonds and v-descent (DiamondsAndVStacks D0-D4), adic étale geometry A0-A3 and PerfectoidQuotients Q4 - on top of tilting and almost purity.

Perfectoid spaces is deep but sits on a substantial built adic-space foundation; (φ,Γ)-modules has nothing at all in the baseline (zero hits for Robba, field of norms, overconvergent, Herr, Wach) and its own eight stages - Fontaine's equivalence, Cherbonnier-Colmez overconvergence, the Herr complex with Tate duality, the ψ-complex and Wach modules - stack on top of PadicHodgeTheory's annulus period rings, PadicMeasuresIwasawaAlgebras, LocallyAnalyticDistributions and SelmerIwasawaCohomology, plus 4 stages of PerfectoidSpaces itself.

(φ,Γ)-modules needs one local p-adic chain plus its p-adic Hodge and Iwasawa-algebra suppliers, 48 external stages over 16 roadmaps. Modularity of elliptic curves over Q imports the entire Serre-modularity and modularity-lifting tower (Taylor-Wiles patching, global and local deformation rings, Serre weights and level optimisation), Faltings' isogeny theorem, modular curves and their Jacobians, and automorphic Galois representations - 472 external stages over 70 roadmaps at depth 19, including the whole étale-cohomological universe.

Heegner-point Euler systems has modularity of elliptic curves as a named prerequisite and its closure contains EllipticCurveModularity's stages outright, then adds ring class fields and the main theorem of complex multiplication (hence all of class field theory, whose ideles are not begun), CM points on modular and Shimura curves with Néron models, the abstract Kolyvagin-system engine ES.1-ES.8, Gross-Zagier heights, and anticyclotomic Iwasawa theory - 551 external stages over 85 roadmaps at depth 22.

PEL moduli must build abelian schemes, polarisations and Rosati involutions, algebraic spaces and stacks with Artin representability, and Shimura data, canonical models and complex uniformization - 73 external stages. Heegner-point Euler systems contains 6 of PELModuli's own stages in its closure and adds modularity, class field theory, Kolyvagin systems, Gross-Zagier and anticyclotomic main conjectures on top.

Both need a whole geometric universe that is absent: PEL moduli needs abelian schemes, stacks and Shimura canonical models (73 external stages, depth 11), the Weil conjectures need étale cohomology with the trace formula and Poincaré duality, Deligne's purity from DeligneWeightsAndPurity, Lefschetz pencils and vanishing cycles, and rigid/crystalline Frobenius (106 external stages, depth 13). The étale-cohomological tower plus Weil II is the longer stack, and grep finds zero declarations for étale cohomology or crystalline cohomology anywhere.

Prismatic cohomology is entirely unbuilt (zero hits for prism, δ-ring, Nygaard, crystalline, de Rham-Witt) and needs δ-rings, crystalline and derived de Rham cohomology, animated algebra, 7 of PerfectoidSpaces' 10 stages and THH/TC from RefinedTraceMethods; the Weil conjectures need the étale site, the Grothendieck-Lefschetz trace formula, Poincaré duality, Deligne's Weil II purity, Lefschetz pencils and rigid cohomology. The Weil side is the longer stack - 106 external stages at depth 13 against 95 at depth 7 - because Weil II sits at the top of the full étale tower.

Semisimple algebras is finished through Layer 6 with no gap, down to BrauerGroup ℝ ≃ ℤ/2 in TauCeti/Algebra/BrauerGroup/Real.lean. Ado-Iwasawa has no file at all and needs the injectivity half of PBW, the nilradical, noncommutative derivations of U(L), derivation-stable cofinite ideals, Levi decomposition and Weyl complete reducibility in general characteristic zero, plus the whole characteristic-p central p-polynomial route.

(φ,Γ)-modules needs the Robba/field-of-norms coefficient rings, Fontaine's equivalence, overconvergence and the Herr and ψ complexes, over p-adic Hodge annulus theory and Iwasawa algebras - 48 external stages over 16 roadmaps. Prismatic cohomology needs δ-rings and prisms, crystalline cohomology, derived de Rham cohomology and animated rings, the Cartier-Witt stack, log prismatics and THH/TC, and its closure swallows 7 of PerfectoidSpaces' 10 stages plus PerfectoidQuotients, DiamondsAndVStacks and AdicSpacesPartII entire - 95 external stages over 20 roadmaps.

Prismatic cohomology's core is untouched by the baseline and its tower (prisms, crystalline, derived de Rham, perfectoid, Nygaard, Cartier-Witt, THH) is formidable, but it is one connected tower of 95 external stages at depth 7. Q-series must build seven largely independent bodies - Rademacher/Kloosterman asymptotics, metaplectic half-integral weight forms, harmonic Maass forms, Zwegers' mock completions, Habiro and quantum invariants, modular curves, and the moonshine VOA/Monster/no-ghost/Borcherds chain - for 131 external stages over 27 roadmaps at depth 12, even though partitions, eta, theta and Delta are already in Mathlib.

Root systems are done, Layers 1-6, sorry-free, including the Cartan-Killing classification and the per-type simply connected root data. Analytic number theory still needs the zero-free region and Wiener-Ikehara for PNT, explicit formulas and zero-density estimates, Hecke L-functions over ideles that do not exist, mean-value theory, and the prehomogeneous-zeta and Selberg-trace-formula stages with their adelic and automorphic imports.

Perfectoid spaces needs almost mathematics, tilting, almost purity and the diamond/v-descent machinery on a built adic-space base - 46 external stages over 11 roadmaps. Modularity over Q needs all of that too (7 PerfectoidSpaces stages sit in its closure) and then the Serre conjecture, Taylor-Wiles patching, deformation rings, Faltings finiteness, modular curves and automorphic Galois representations, for 472 external stages over 70 roadmaps.

Reductive groups II needs buildings, parahorics, Weil restriction and the conjugacy theorems its base roadmap still lacks - large, but one theory with no cohomological prerequisites. The Weil conjectures need étale cohomology built from the site up with the trace formula, Poincaré duality, Deligne's purity from Weil II, Lefschetz pencils and vanishing cycles, and rigid cohomology - 106 external stages over 21 roadmaps at depth 13, with zero étale-cohomology declarations in either library.

(φ,Γ)-modules is a single deep local chain - Robba rings, Fontaine's equivalence, overconvergence, Herr and ψ complexes, Wach modules - on top of p-adic Hodge and Iwasawa-algebra suppliers. PEL moduli needs abelian schemes, polarisations and Rosati involutions, level structures, algebraic spaces and stacks with Artin representability and deformation theory, Shimura data and Shimura varieties with canonical models and CM reciprocity, and complex uniformization with the ker^1(Q,G) obstruction; none of abelian schemes, algebraic stacks or Shimura varieties has a single declaration in either library.

Q-series is broad and reaches moonshine, but its first two stages already have Mathlib's partition generating function, eta, Jacobi theta and Delta, and Tau Ceti's modular-forms tree. Heegner-point Euler systems needs modularity of elliptic curves, full class field theory with ring class fields, modular and Shimura curves with Néron models and CM descent, the Kolyvagin-system engine, Gross-Zagier heights and anticyclotomic Iwasawa theory - 551 external stages over 85 roadmaps at depth 22, the largest closure in the block.

Ado-Iwasawa is eight layers of finite-dimensional Lie theory with no external imports, on a baseline that already has Engel, solvability, base change and the PBW filtration. Class field theory has thirteen unbuilt layers stacked in a normative order - class formations, Tate's theorem, the Artin map, the local Brauer invariant and Kummer/duality package, the local class formation and existence, the Weil group, the Brauer sequence with both fundamental inequalities, global reciprocity and existence, the class fields and Kronecker-Weber - and the ideles and ray class groups it consumes have not been started in GlobalNumberFields.

Prismatic cohomology's closure contains 7 of PerfectoidSpaces' 10 stages together with PerfectoidQuotients, DiamondsAndVStacks and AdicSpacesPartII, and then adds δ-rings and prisms, crystalline and derived de Rham cohomology, animated algebra, the Nygaard filtration, the Cartier-Witt stack, log prismatics and the THH/TC filtration - 95 external stages against 46.

Reductive groups II is wholly unbuilt (zero declarations for buildings, parahorics or Weil restriction) and its base still lacks conjugacy of maximal tori, so it is far in its own right. But analytic number theory's closure literally contains 2 stages of ReductiveGroupsPartII, reached through AdelicAlgebraicGroups and SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups, and adds the whole analytic programme on top: PNT, explicit formulas, Hecke L-functions over ideles, mean values, prehomogeneous zeta and the Selberg trace formula - 69 external stages over 19 roadmaps at depth 12.
